newsitem.title: USA: Compost America unsure why stock is down.
newsitem.headline: Compost America unsure why stock is down.

text.p: Compost America Holding Co Inc said Wednesday it knows of no reason for the recent share price decline in its common stock.
As of Wednesday trading on the Nasdaq bulletin board, the company's stock price had fallen 75 percent to 1-5/16 from its high earlier this year of 5-1/4. It has traded as low as 1-1/16.

Company president and chief executive officer Roger Tuttle said investor interest should increase as the positive fundamentals that are driving the company's current and future growth continue to unfold and become better known to the investment community.
Compost America said it has been successful in implementing its business plan and corporate alliances.

In order to establish a national presence, Compost America is pursuing a strategy of identifying and trying to acquire key operating companies that should provide corporate cash flow during the construction phase of its indoor in-vessel composting facilities, it said.
